## Exact delta

alive checks, read candidate HP once, require strict `candidate_hp < hp` BEFORE
calling `reachable(c,false)`. On success, retain the camp handle and assign hp
from that sampled value. Preserve strict ties and iteration order. Use the
strict less-than expression (including its floating-point semantics), not a
different comparison. Cache only within this iteration; no cross-turn state.

Enemy selection/priority, travel/task guards, reachable implementation, ability
selection/scoring, basic/cast order, all current-round/fuel guards and all other
files' production behavior remain unchanged. No new telemetry or instrumentation.
Intended selection equivalence is for a fixed live state; fuel/suspension timing
can change and must be tested in uninstrumented release. Do not optimize other
loops opportunistically. Preserve original navigation and all inherited gates.
